component.name: Asima Hub
component.summary: Get Asima OS, its news and its updates

description.p: Asima Hub brings you to Asima OS and keeps it up to date. It shows what Asima OS will do on your PC, downloads the newest version and writes it to a USB stick, checked from start to end.

On Asima OS it downloads new versions and hands them to Asima Updater, shows the project's news and what is new in each version, opens the guides and the wiki, and helps you send a problem report by email.

description.p: The first version of Asima Hub: what Asima OS will do on this PC, the download and the USB stick, updates handed to Asima Updater, the project's news from a signed feed, and problem reports by email.
